rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when someone acts of their own free will.

example.english: Joining this activity was voluntary; nobody forced me.
example.traditional: 呢次參加義工活動係我自己願意嘅，冇人逼我。
example.jyutping: nei1 ci3 caam1 gaa1 ji6 gung1 wut6 dung6 hai6 ngo5 zi6 gei2 jyun6 ji3 ge3 mou5 jan4 bik1 ngo5

rows.note: Use this when the action was intentional rather than accidental, not when it merely reflects free choice.

example.english: Breaking the window was voluntary and not accidental.
example.traditional: 打爛塊玻璃係故意，唔係意外。
example.jyutping: daa2 laan6 faai3 bo1 lei4 hai6 gu3 ji3 m4 hai6 ji3 ngoi6

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase for work or a service for which no payment is received.

example.english: We helped a neighbor move today on a voluntary basis, so we received no payment.
example.traditional: 我哋今日幫街坊搬屋，冇錢收㗎。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 jat6 bong1 gaai1 fong1 bun1 uk1 mou5 cin2 sau1 gaa3
